description: The agent must: (1) Read the order request and locate all relevant data files. (2) Discover that Swiggy's connector is failing (HTTP 401 / session expired mid-cart) from swiggy/search_results.json, and explain this failure clearly before switching to Zomato. (3) Present up to 3 Zomato restaurant options sourced from zomato/search_results.json. (4) Apply the SKILL.md vendor routing logic (lower payable → faster ETA → better rating) to recommend the best Zomato option within the ₹800 budget. (5) Detect and flag the address ambiguity — the address book contains TWO entries labeled 'office' and must ask Priya to clarify which one before proceeding. (6) Surface the COD-only and non-cancellable constraint for the selected Zomato restaurant in the Notes field. (7) Produce a confirmation prompt using the EXACT SKILL.md format with all required fields: 'Vendor:', 'Restaurant:', 'Items:', 'Total payable:', 'Delivery address:', 'ETA:', 'Notes:', ending with 'Confirm order? (yes/no)'. The COD and non-cancellable warnings MUST appear under Notes. The entire output must be saved as order_response.json.
